name: Heal
summary: Restores 70 Hit Points to a creature and ends Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned.

stats.effect: Choose a creature that you can see within range. Positive energy washes through the target, restoring 70 Hit Points. This spell also ends the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions on the target.
stats.higherLevels: The healing increases by 10 for each spell slot level above 6.
